risks.description: The presegmentation cannot be properly evaluated because there are no reference annotations except the one it was trained on
Where a speaker barely talks on their channel the normalisation breaks down and the system does not work at all

open_questions.description: Whether the transcribers can mark speech versus non-speech per channel on some meetings, to give the presegmentation an evaluation reference
Whether to run phonetic feature analysis on the nonword vocalisations -- the uh-huhs, hmms, grunts and other interruption devices

notes: me011's 'so use ninetieth quartile rather than minimum' (seg-0053) is NOT recorded as a decision. mn014 answers 'Yeah, then I did some things like that' -- me011 is working out what mn014 already built, so it is a description of completed work, not something the meeting settles. The nonword-features suggestion is recorded as an open question even though me013 closes it with 'We should move on' (seg-0024): being deflected is not being answered, and the extractor sees the same deflection.
